culprit_citations.quoted_text: FS NU Investors, LP | (a) | (6) | Consumer Services | 20.00 % ( 100 % PIK) | 8/9/2024 | 2 | 169 | 204 | 0.01

findings.detail: The source prints 20.00% (100% PIK) under the All-In Rate column for an equity investment, not as a Spread or basis_spread value.

rationale: C115 flagged basis_spread=20.0. The raw SOI source row for FS NU Investors, LP is in a Common and Preferred Equity Investments table whose header has All-In Rate, and the cited row shows 20.00 % (100 % PIK) in that All-In Rate position. That supports a 20% PIK/all-in rate, but not a basis spread, so the stored basis_spread is a localized extraction/column mapping error.
